audit.whatIsWrong: winCon claimed 'your drain math wins it from level 6 onward' while the content layer, packet chart and spikes all say 6 onward is Yone's window.
audit.why: His R Fate Sealed + E recall out-ranges Swain's 650-range R uptime; survivability items outlast the drain.
audit.corrected: winCon rewritten to the actual shape: win pre-6, peel after.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[0]/[5]/[6] and the packet say Swain / Yone / Yone.
audit.why: Level 1: 750-range Q vs a comboless melee. First item and 2+ items: survivability spike outlasts R drain, E-recall dive beats single-target lockdown.
audit.corrected: phases[0]/[5]/[6].side moved with matching whys and ratings; content sides already correct so full sides edited alone per the chart rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Page called Yone's E 'untargetable' in whys[6], spikes[3] and late — Soul Unbound does not make him untargetable (no such flag, and Riot's text says only his spirit leaves his body). breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; two bleed bullets.
audit.why: Kit: E 22/19/16/13/10, W shield 14s base, R 120s and knockup-gated.
audit.corrected: 'Untargetable' claims replaced with E-recall phrasing; real cooldowns written in; bleed bullets rewritten.

edits.before: Accept the brawl he offers — your drain math wins it from level 6 onward. Shorthand: Soul Unbound down, wave right, go.
edits.after: Win the lane before 6 — poke him off the wave, deny Q3 setups, and after his spike peel with E and let your jungler flip fights.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Nevermove has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1, 10s max — survive the spirit window and punish the body he snaps back to. - W Spirit Cleave shields on a 14s base — poke between shields. - His R Fate Sealed is 120s and needs a knockup: no Q3, no R.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension drains minions too — brawling inside your own wave adds healing targets while his snap-back body must return into your root range.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: Every second auto is magic damage with doubled crit chance — auto wars feed Way of the Hunter; trade with spells at range.

edits.before: Q-poke through the wave — the hand hurts more than people remember. Farm safely; your real spells arrive next.
edits.after: Yone has no trading combo at level 1 — your 750-range Q chunks him on every last-hit before his kit exists.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: the drain outpaces their damage in any extended fight. Force rivers, root the entry, ascend, profit.
edits.after: His survivability buy outlasts your R drain — the extended trade you want is now the one he wins. Play for the map instead.

edits.before: Late Swain is the anti-team: flank-root their engage, ascend in their backline, and demonflare the clump that forms around you.
edits.after: Two-item Yone dives through your R with the E-recall safety net — you are the peeler now: root his committed dash, not his feint.

edits.before: With two-plus items Yone's untargetable dive and burst overpower your single-target lockdown, so the scaling favours him.
edits.after: With two-plus items Yone's E-recall dive and crit burst overpower your single-target lockdown, so the scaling favours him.

edits.before: With two items Yone's burst plus untargetable E and knock-up chain lets him dive your backline through your R, so you're a frontline peeler here, not the win condition. Save Nevermove for his committed dash and R to survive the follow-up, not to open.
edits.after: With two items Yone's burst plus the E-recall safety net and knock-up chain lets him dive your backline through your R, so you're a frontline peeler here, not the win condition. Save Nevermove for his committed dash and R to survive the follow-up, not to open.

edits.before: From level 6 on Yone pulls ahead. His R Fate Sealed plus the E recall gives him a longer, safer all-in than your R can answer, and once he adds a survivability or lifesteal item he outlasts your Demonic Ascension drain. Pivot to peeling for your team, spacing his untargetable windows, and using E purely to punish his committed dashes.
edits.after: From level 6 on Yone pulls ahead. His R Fate Sealed plus the E recall gives him a longer, safer all-in than your R can answer, and once he adds a survivability or lifesteal item he outlasts your Demonic Ascension drain. Pivot to peeling for your team, spacing his Soul Unbound windows, and using E purely to punish his committed dashes.
